map.计算LTV与CAC的健康比率，评估客户价值与获客成本的平衡关系: Compute the healthy ratio between LTV and CAC to assess the balance between customer value and acquisition cost
map.📖 查看「LTV:CAC比率计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "LTV:CAC Ratio Calculator User Guide"
map.客户生命周期总贡献价值: Total value contributed over the customer lifetime
map.获取一个新客户的成本: Cost of winning one new customer
map.LTV:CAC比率是衡量业务健康度的核心指标，用于评估客户终身价值与获客成本之间: The LTV:CAC ratio is a core measure of business health, assessing the relation between customer lifetime value and acquisition cost. It reflects the return a company earns on its investment in customers.
map.LTV:CAC比率 = 客户终身价值(LTV) / 客户获取成本(CAC): LTV:CAC ratio = customer lifetime value (LTV) / customer acquisition cost (CAC)
map.例如：LTV为3000元，CAC为500元，则 LTV:CAC = 3000 /: For example with LTV of 3000 CNY and CAC of 500 CNY, LTV:CAC = 3000 / 500 = 6:1.
map.：健康，客户价值远超获客成本: : healthy, customer value far exceeds acquisition cost
map.：需要优化，利润空间有限: : needs optimization, profit headroom is limited
map.：亏损，每获取一个客户都在亏钱: : losing money, every new customer costs more than it returns
map.3:1的比率意味着每花1元获取客户，能获得3元的终身价值。这个比率既能保证足够的: A 3:1 ratio means every 1 CNY spent acquiring a customer returns 3 CNY of lifetime value. This leaves enough margin while still funding continued growth. The SaaS industry usually treats 3:1 as the healthy baseline.
map.：提高复购率、增加客单价、延长客户生命周期: : increase repurchase rate, average order value and customer lifetime
map.：优化获客渠道、提高转化率、利用口碑传播: : optimize acquisition channels, raise conversion rate and use word of mouth
map.：聚焦高价值客户群体，优化资源配置: : focus on high-value customer segments and allocate resources better
map.看获客投入与用户终身价值的回报比。: Look at the return ratio between acquisition spend and lifetime value.
map.比值≥3 健康、2–3 良好、1–2 偏低、<1 危险。: A ratio ≥ 3 is healthy, 2-3 good, 1-2 low and < 1 dangerous.
map.与可加大投放的空间。: and the headroom for more spend.
map.LTV=3000、CAC=500 → 比值=3000/500=6:1，利润=25: LTV = 3000 and CAC = 500 gives a ratio of 3000/500 = 6:1, profit = 2500 and ROI = 2500/500×100 = 500%, far above the 3:1 health line, so budget can be increased.
map.LTV=800、CAC=1000 → 比值 0.8:1 <1，每获客亏 200，: LTV = 800 and CAC = 1000 gives 0.8:1, below 1, losing 200 on every customer acquired; CAC must fall or LTV rise before spending more.
map.经验值：留 1 份覆盖 CAC、1 份覆盖服务与变动成本、1 份作利润，低于 3: It is a rule of thumb: one part covers CAC, one covers service and variable cost and one is profit; below 3, hidden costs are hard to cover.
map.比值高但要不要无限加投？: If the ratio is high, should spend increase without limit?
map.不是。边际 CAC 随规模上升，比值会衰减，应在比值跌破 3 前停止加量。: No. Marginal CAC rises with scale and the ratio decays, so stop adding volume before the ratio falls below 3.
